The '''Work Zone sector''' was a sector of [[Prak City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]].

==History==
The Work Zone sector was one of the older parts of the city and was originally formed when mining prospectors set up encampments there. However, with the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], construction firms were brought in to redevelop the sector and it became increasingly ghettoized.
